patthana3.9:1.1: parāmāsaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:2.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.9:4.1: parāmāsaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:5.1: no parāmāsaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.9:6.1: parāmāsaṃ akusalañca no parāmāsaṃ akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana3.9:7.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe pañca, avigate pañca,
patthana3.9:8.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ, na adhipatiyā pañca, na purejāte pañca, na pacchājāte pañca, (sahajātavāraṃpi sampayuttavāraṃpi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana3.9:9.1: no parāmāso akusalo dhammo no parāmāsassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.9:10.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate pañca,
patthana3.9:11.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccanīyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.9:12.1: no parāmāsaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:13.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.9:15.1: parāmaṭṭhaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:16.1: aparāmaṭṭhaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aparāmaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:17.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, avigate dve.
patthana3.9:19.1: parāmaṭṭhaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana3.9:20.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.9:22.1: parāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:23.1: aparāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aparāmaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.9:24.1: parāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākatañca aparāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:25.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, (sahajātavāraṃpi pañhāvāraṃpi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana3.9:26.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:27.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.9:29.1: parāmāsasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:31.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, sabbattha dve, avigate dve,
patthana3.9:32.1: na hetuyā ekaṃ, na adhipatiyā dve, sabbattha dve. …pe… na vippayutte dve, (sahajātavāropi sampayuttavāropi vitthāretabbo.)
patthana3.9:33.1: parāmāsasampayutto akusalo dhammo parāmāsasampayuttassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.9:35.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā cattāri, majjhali ca? aggali ca? ārammaṇādhipati anantare dve, sahajāte dve, upanissaye cattāri, āsevane dve. kamme dve, āhāre dve. …pe… magge dve, …pe…
patthana3.9:36.1: parāmāsa vippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:37.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.9:39.1: no ca parāmāsaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:40.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.
patthana3.9:42.1: parāmāsaṃ ceva parāmaṭṭhaṃ ca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ,
patthana3.9:43.1: parāmaṭṭhaṃ ceva no ca parāmāsaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana3.9:44.1: parāmāsañceva parāmaṭṭhaṃ ca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ ceva no ca parāmāsaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ
patthana3.9:45.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe pañca, avigate pañca,
patthana3.9:47.1: parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso akusalo dhammo parāmaṭṭhassa ceva no ca parāmāsassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana3.9:48.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, avigate pañca,
patthana3.9:49.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccanīyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.)
patthana3.9:50.1: parāmaṭṭhañceva no ca parāmāsaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmaṭṭho ceva no ca parāmāso abyākato dhamme uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:51.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ, sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha ekaṃ.
patthana3.9:52.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto parāmaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:53.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto aparāmaṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:54.1: hetuyā dve, avigate dve, (lokiyalokuttara dukatikasadisaṃ sahajātavāropi pañhāvāropi vitthāretabbo.)
patthana3.9:55.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto parāmaṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, sabbattha ekaṃ.
patthana3.9:56.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto parāmaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana3.9:57.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto aparāmaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.9:58.1: parāmāsavippayuttaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃ ca parāmāsavippayuttaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃca dhammaṃ paṭicca parāmāsavippayutto parāmaṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.9:59.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, (lokiya lokuttara dukatika sadisaṃ sahajātavāraṃpi pañhāvāraṃpi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
